entries.label: CM1 1악장 기름 부음 (45.5s)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. One continuous movement, 45 seconds, never stopping or restarting: a cinematic chamber-orchestra piece of quiet wonder. A slow, noble four-note anointing theme in E minor runs through all of it; every change grows out of what is already playing. 0–8 s: a solo cello alone plays the theme very softly, intimate and close, like a candle in a dark room, with a faint low string pedal on E. At about 8 s a harp joins with slow rippling figures like water in late-afternoon light, the cello answering. At about 14 s everything thins to one suspended high violin note with faint glassy harmonics, still and expectant, for five seconds. At about 19.5 s near silence for one breath. At 20.3 s a radiant warm bloom: full strings, soft French horns and a wordless choir state the theme in E major, the fullest moment of the movement around 21.5 s, then easing by 23.5 s. At about 23.5 s a soft wooden shepherd's flute takes the theme over warm low strings, a hillside at sunset, quiet under a spoken voice; at about 29 s the strings rise warmly and gently for four seconds, like oil poured out, then settle. At about 36 s it turns solemn and hushed: low strings and one soft horn, reverent. At about 40 s the cello takes the theme back over the harp, a gentle lift at 42 s, and at 44 s the harmony darkens toward minor, as if continuing. Slow tempo, about 60 BPM, spacious, mid-range kept clear for a voice, no drums, no synths.
entries.name: CM1

entries.label: CM2 2악장 길과 십자가 (55s)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. One continuous movement, 55 seconds, never stopping or restarting, continuing a piece already in progress (the same slow four-note anointing theme in E minor). 0–7 s: the color turns cold and grand: low brass and low strings in minor with a deep, soft frame-drum pulse, stern and imperial, wind on stone walls. At about 7 s warmth returns: a steady walking low-string ostinato with a softly plucked oud, a band of men on a dusty road at golden hour, and the solo cello sings the theme above it, quiet under a spoken voice. At about 11 s one warm, bright major chord blooms for two seconds, then the walk goes on. At about 15 s the harmony darkens and the walking slows and hesitates, the theme in minor, unease growing. At about 23 s tension: quick string tremolo and a dissonant viola cry, urgent, for four seconds. At about 27 s it empties to a solo cello and one faint high glassy note, alone at dusk, the first star. At about 32 s intimate and ancient: a harp and a solo viola in minor, lamplight on an old scroll, very quiet under a voice. At about 43 s grave darkness: one low string drone and a slow, sparse lament on solo cello, bare, no warmth. At about 47.5 s it sinks lower and darker, almost silent. At about 52 s only a single warm low note remains, held, like an ember, fading to the end. Slow tempo, mid-range kept clear for a voice, no synths.
entries.name: CM2

entries.label: CM3 3악장 이미 적힌 길 (52s)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. One continuous movement, 52 seconds, never stopping or restarting, continuing a piece already in progress (the same slow four-note anointing theme in E minor). 0–1 s from near silence: a soft celesta spark and a harp note, like a lamp catching flame. From about 1 s a solo violin sings the theme as an ancient psalm-lament over a quiet low string pad and a plucked lyre, sorrowful, very quiet under a spoken voice. At about 5.4 s a soft glassy shimmer of high strings swells for two seconds and settles; at about 11.6 s the same shimmer once more. At about 16.5 s dry and sparse: a few low pizzicato notes, stark daylight, waiting. At about 22.4 s warmth and resolve: strings begin to move forward gently, hopeful, the cello carrying the theme. At about 27 s luminous and airy: high strings, a soft wordless choir and slow descending harp, a pale gentle light coming down, tender and still, quiet under a voice, for ten seconds. At about 37.5 s it goes cold and bare: one low drone only. At about 40 s, with no voice, one grave, aching full string chord swells alone for two seconds, the most sorrowful moment, then fades to a hush. At about 42 s dawn: the strings rise slowly and gently into E major with a soft choir hum, the first warm light, then warm and calm under a voice to the end. Slow tempo, no drums, no synths.
entries.name: CM3

entries.label: CM4 4악장 한 분에게 (32s)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. One continuous movement, 32 seconds, never stopping or restarting, continuing a piece already in progress (the same slow four-note anointing theme, now in E major). It opens on warm sustained strings. At about 0.4 s a French horn plays the first phrase of the theme, rising; at about 2.8 s the phrase again, a step higher, with more strings; at about 5.2 s a third time, higher still, with a soft choir: three rising steps. From about 7.4 s everything gathers and builds steadily. At about 9.7 s a radiant, full swell: full orchestra and wordless choir state the theme in E major, like the sun rising, the fullest and brightest moment of the whole score around 10.5 s. At about 11.6 s it settles into peace: solo cello and harp over warm sustained strings, candlelight and morning, quiet under a spoken voice. At about 18.8 s tender and close. At about 24.6 s the strings softly state the theme one last time. At about 27 s a breath of near silence, then at about 27.6 s one long, warm open E major chord that decays slowly to silence by the end. Slow tempo, no drums, no synths.
entries.name: CM4

entries.label: CM5 승 — 기대·고백·뒤집힘 (#49)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. Cinematic orchestral film score, one continuous 41-second movement with a wide dynamic range and a clear rising arc of tension, continuing a piece already in progress: the same slow, noble four-note theme in E minor. 0–3 s: a stern, imperial entrance, low brass chords and a deep frame drum, firm and proud. 3–10 s: a restrained martial pulse of low strings and soft frame drum, held back and quiet, with a brief brass swell at about 8 s. 10–15 s: warmer, a gentle walking low-string ostinato with a softly plucked oud, the solo cello sings the theme, quiet. At about 15.5 s a sudden radiant bloom: full strings and French horns state the theme in E major, bright and strong, for two seconds. At about 18 s the major chord darkens into minor and a low, uneasy pulsing ostinato begins, quiet but restless, slowly quickening. At about 24 s a rushing string tremolo crescendo, urgent. At about 26 s agitated, sharp string figures. At about 28 s a loud dissonant brass and viola cry, the most tense moment so far, then at about 30 s it drops to a hollow low drone with a soft pizzicato heartbeat. From about 35 s suspense: high strings hold a long trembling note while a slow, soft timpani heartbeat grows steadily louder, anticipation building to the end without resolving. Slow tempo, about 60 BPM, organic orchestra, no synths, no drum kit.
entries.name: CM5

entries.label: CM6 전1 — 이사야·외침·시편 22 성취 (#49)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. Cinematic orchestral film score, one continuous 40-second movement with a wide dynamic range, from crushing grief to a shivering, chill-inducing build, continuing a piece already in progress: the same slow, noble four-note theme in E minor. 0–6 s: a grave lament, solo cello over low sustained strings and a slow, soft timpani heartbeat. At about 6 s the sorrow swells, more strings join. From about 7.5 s a long, heavy crescendo, the lament growing louder and darker with low brass. At about 10 s the most crushing moment: full low brass, strings fortissimo and a rolling timpani, then at about 11.3 s it cuts off almost to silence. 11.3–17.5 s: near silence, only one thin trembling high violin note. From about 17.5 s, out of the stillness, a low pulse returns with an ancient harp, and a slow repeating string ostinato begins, mysterious, quiet. From 23 s the ostinato builds layer by layer, rising in pitch and intensity, higher violins, a soft wordless choir, tingling and awed, with a swell at about 28 s. At about 32.5 s a huge crescendo with a timpani roll, and at about 34 s the full orchestra and choir state the theme in E minor, grand, tragic and powerful, holding strong until about 39 s, then easing slightly. Slow tempo, about 60 BPM, organic orchestra, no synths, no drum kit.

entries.label: CM7 전2 — 베드로의 증언·나무·부활 (#49)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. Cinematic orchestral film score, one continuous 30-second movement with a dramatic reversal from darkness to triumph, continuing a piece already in progress: the same slow, noble four-note theme, moving from E minor to E major. 0–5 s: warmth returns, the cello sings the theme over a gentle, hopeful forward pulse of low strings and harp. 5–13 s: steadily growing, strings rising, walking forward with hope. 13–16 s: the harmony turns dark and an ominous swell of low brass and strings rises. At about 16 s one deep, heavy low drum hit, then a bare grave low drone, hushed. At about 18.5 s from near silence a string tremolo and timpani roll build in a fast crescendo, and at about 20.5 s everything bursts into radiant, triumphant E major: full orchestra, wordless choir, bright horns, bells and timpani, the theme in glory, the brightest moment so far, fullest around 23 s. From about 24 s it stays warm and glowing, high strings shimmering and the choir sustaining, softer but never empty, to the end. Slow tempo, about 60 BPM, organic orchestra, no synths, no drum kit.
entries.name: CM7

entries.label: CM8 결 — 세 직분이 한 분에게·마지막 고백 (#48 #49)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. Cinematic orchestral film score, one continuous 32-second finale, continuing a piece already in progress: the same slow, noble four-note theme, now in E major. It opens on warm sustained strings. At about 0.4 s a French horn plays the first phrase of the theme, strong and rising; at about 2.8 s the phrase again a step higher with more strings and a timpani stroke; at about 5.2 s a third time, higher still, with choir: three ascending steps. From about 7.5 s a steady, powerful build. At about 9.6 s the biggest climax of the whole score: full orchestra and wordless choir fortissimo state the theme in E major, majestic and overwhelming, until about 11.5 s. 11.5–22 s: it settles into a warm, confident and noble glow, the theme carried by strings and horns over a steady gentle pulse, never thin. From about 22 s it rises again, and from 23 s a long crescendo grows under the theme, fuller and fuller. At about 27.5 s a final radiant statement of the theme by full orchestra and choir, broad and triumphant, held, then from about 30 s one long ringing E major chord that is still sounding at the very end, not fading away. Slow tempo, about 60 BPM, organic orchestra, no synths, no drum kit.
entries.name: CM8

entries.label: CM9 승 긴장 — 고난 예고·그리 마옵소서·이미 적혀 (#49)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. Tense cinematic orchestral underscore in E minor, one continuous piece of rising unease, continuing a piece already in progress. 0–6 s: a soft, uneasy low string pulse in steady eighth notes with a quiet low drone, restless. At about 6.5 s a rushing string tremolo crescendo, urgent and growing loud. At about 8 s agitated, sharp, stabbing string figures. At about 10 s a loud, harsh dissonant brass and string cry, the most tense and loudest moment, held for two seconds. At about 12.5 s it suddenly drops away to a hollow low drone with a soft pizzicato heartbeat, unsettled and quiet. From about 17 s suspense: high strings hold a long, trembling note and a slow timpani heartbeat grows steadily louder and closer, anticipation without resolution, still building at the end. Slow tempo, about 60 BPM, organic orchestra, no synths, no drum kit.
entries.name: CM9

entries.label: CM10 끝 — 마지막 고백에서 끝 화면까지 이어 터짐 (#48)
entries.prompt: Instrumental only. Triumphant cinematic orchestral finale in E major with wordless choir, continuing a piece already in progress. 0–2.5 s: warm strings and horns, noble, gently lifting. From about 2.5 s a steady, swelling crescendo, fuller and fuller, timpani roll growing. At about 7 s the full orchestra and choir state a broad, radiant four-note theme fortissimo, glorious and overwhelming, the biggest moment. It stays full and shining, held, until about 11 s, then one long ringing E major chord of full strings, horns and choir that keeps sounding strongly to the very end, never fading out, never stopping. Slow, majestic, about 60 BPM, no synths, no drum kit.
entries.name: CM10
